title: AI Video Maker
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION AI Video Creator & Architectural Visualisation Artist Company: Arcwell Architecture Location: New Town, Kolkata Employment Type: Full-time Experience: 1–3 years preferred; talented freshers may apply About Arcwell Architecture Arcwell Architecture is a design-focused architectural firm specialising in residential, commercial, and interior design projects. We are looking for a creative and tech-savvy AI Video Creator who can transform architectural designs, 3D renders, and SketchUp models into engaging, cinematic videos using AI tools and professional video-editing software. Key Responsibilities - Create AI-generated architectural videos, cinematic walkthroughs, and project reveal videos. - Convert still renders and 3D visualisations into realistic animations using AI video-generation tools. - Create promotional reels, YouTube Shorts, Instagram videos, and other social media content. - Develop cinematic sequences featuring realistic camera movements, lighting, landscaping, people, and environmental effects. - Work with architectural drawings, SketchUp models, renders, and reference images. - Use AI tools to enhance visual quality, create transitions, and generate engaging storytelling content. - Edit videos with professional colour grading, music, sound effects, subtitles, and branding. - Create project presentations, marketing videos, and before-and-after renovation videos. - Maintain the original architectural design, building geometry, and material intent while creating animations. - Coordinate with architects and the marketing team to deliver content within deadlines. Required Skills - Knowledge of AI video-generation tools such as Kling AI, Runway, Google Veo, Luma AI, or similar platforms. - Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. - Experience with AI image-generation and enhancement tools such as Midjourney, Nano Banana, or similar platforms. - Understanding of architectural visualisation, composition, perspective, lighting, and camera movement. - Ability to create high-quality vertical reels (9:16) and cinematic videos (16:9). - Creative storytelling skills and a good understanding of social media trends. - Ability to follow architectural references accurately and maintain visual consistency across video sequences. Preferred Qualifications - Experience in an architecture, interior design, real estate, or visualisation studio. - Knowledge of SketchUp, Lumion, D5 Render, Twinmotion, V-Ray, or Unreal Engine. - Experience creating realistic exterior and interior walkthroughs. - A portfolio demonstrating AI-generated videos, architectural animations, or cinematic reels. Performance Expectations - Deliver high-quality architectural videos and social media content consistently. - Produce visually realistic, engaging, and brand-aligned content. - Demonstrate creativity while preserving design accuracy. - Meet project deadlines and respond effectively to feedback. Salary & Benefits - Salary: Based on experience, skills, and portfolio. - Opportunity to work on premium residential and commercial architectural projects. - Creative freedom to experiment with emerging AI technologies. - Professional growth in AI-assisted architectural visualisation and digital marketing. How to Apply Interested candidates should share their CV, portfolio, and links to their best AI-generated videos or architectural reels. Email: [Insert company email] Contact: [Insert contact number] Join Arcwell Architecture and turn architectural visions into cinematic experiences.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
